scenario: Activation-scoped facts are real facts per LSCP.6.5 — queryable by other rules' LHSs. Pin: one rule emits a `scope activation` fact and a second rule matches it as an ordinary positive pattern; this compiles OK.
rules_ds:
schema ProcessLock scope activation:
    entity_id: String

schema Job scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule process:
    Job j
->
    emit ProcessLock entity_id: j.entity_id
    log info "processing"

rule observe:
    ProcessLock p
->
    log info "lock {p.entity_id}"
